question: Short Tandem Repeat (STR) analysis is currently the internationally accepted gold-standard method for forensic DNA profiling.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This is true. STR (Short Tandem Repeat) analysis is the current gold standard for forensic DNA profiling. The technique exploits individual variation at multiple STR loci to generate a unique profile. It has replaced RFLP as the primary method due to sensitivity and PCR-amplifiable quantities.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. STR analysis — examining variable-number tandem repeats at multiple loci — is the standard method used by forensic laboratories worldwide, including in India. It requires very small quantities of DNA and produces a profile that can be compared to known reference samples or databased profiles.
